evals.prompt: 我们用 BullMQ 跑一个 worker 处理 `order.paid` 事件，给买家发一封 HTML 收据邮件（TypeScript，Node 20）。job 失败会被 BullMQ 自动重试最多 5 次，产品要求绝对不能给同一个订单发两封收据。发件人是 receipts@mail.acme.com，回复地址 support@acme.com。请写出 worker 的处理函数和 Resend 调用部分。
evals.expected_output: 使用 resend SDK 的 emails.send，把 `receipt/<orderId>` 之类的幂等键通过 Idempotency-Key（SDK 第二个参数 { idempotencyKey }）传入；replyTo 用 camelCase；检查返回的 { data, error } 而不是只靠 try/catch；对 429/5xx 让 job 抛错重试、对 4xx 不重试。
expectations: Code passes an idempotency key derived from the order id to Resend (via the SDK's options argument `{ idempotencyKey }` or the `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header), so BullMQ retries cannot double-send
Code does not rely solely on try/catch around resend.emails.send(); it checks the returned `error` field (or, if using fetch, inspects the HTTP status / `name` field)
Reply-to is expressed as `replyTo` when using the Node SDK (or `reply_to` in a raw JSON body), not the other way round
Code does not treat 4xx validation/auth errors as retryable, and does treat 429 / 5xx as retryable (throwing so BullMQ retries, or explicit backoff)
The API key is read from an environment variable; no literal key or key-shaped placeholder beyond `process.env.RESEND_API_KEY` appears

evals.prompt: 每天早上 9 点（Asia/Shanghai）要给大约 600 个客户各发一封月度对账单邮件，每个人的对账单是一个单独生成的 PDF（Buffer，~200KB），正文里要带客户名字。用 TypeScript + Resend 写一个 sendStatements(customers) 函数，要求尽量少打 API、别触发限流。
evals.expected_output: 识别出：有附件的邮件不能走 batch（文档说 batch 不支持 attachments/scheduling），因此用单发 POST /emails 逐封发送并做 10 req/s 的并发/节流控制；或者明确说明 batch 的限制并给出取舍。scheduled_at 用 ISO 8601（带时区）而不是自然语言；每封 to 不超过 50；附件用 { filename, content }。
expectations: Code does not put attachments inside a `POST /emails/batch` / `resend.batch.send` payload without at least noting that the docs say batch does not support attachments
If batch is used anywhere, the code chunks to at most 100 emails per request
Throttling/concurrency control keeps requests at or under roughly 10 requests per second (or reads `retry-after` on 429), rather than firing 600 concurrent requests
Attachments are passed as `{ filename, content }` (Buffer or base64) or `{ filename, path }`, not as a bare Buffer or a `data`/`url` field
Any scheduling uses `scheduledAt` (SDK) / `scheduled_at` (REST) with an ISO 8601 timestamp, not a cron string or unix epoch

evals.prompt: 在 Next.js 15 App Router 里写一个 /api/resend-webhook 路由，接收 Resend 的事件：如果是硬退信就把该邮箱在我们数据库里标记为 invalid（有个 markEmailInvalid(email) 函数），如果是投诉就退订。要验证请求确实来自 Resend。TypeScript。
evals.expected_output: 使用 svix 库（或等价的 Svix 签名算法）验证 svix-id / svix-timestamp / svix-signature 三个 header，用 request.text() 拿 raw body；按 payload.type 分发 'email.bounced' / 'email.complained'；从 payload.data.to（数组）取收件地址；bounce 类型从 data.bounce 子对象判断。
expectations: Signature verification uses the Svix scheme (the `svix` package or an equivalent HMAC over `svix-id.svix-timestamp.body`) reading the `svix-id`, `svix-timestamp`, `svix-signature` headers, with the signing secret from an environment variable
The handler reads the raw request body (e.g. `await req.text()`) for verification instead of `req.json()` before verifying
Event types are matched against `email.bounced` and `email.complained` (exact strings), not e.g. `bounce`, `email.bounce`, `complaint`
The recipient address is taken from `data.to` treated as an array (not `data.email` / `data.recipient` as a single string)
No webhook secret or API key literal appears in the code

evals.prompt: 我在 Cloudflare Workers 上跑，不想装 resend 这个 npm 包。用原生 fetch 写一个最小的 Resend 客户端（TypeScript）：sendEmail(params) 和 listEmails() 两个方法，listEmails 要能翻完所有页。错误要抛成带错误类型名的 Error。
evals.expected_output: fetch 到 https://api.resend.com/emails，header 含 Authorization: Bearer、User-Agent、Content-Type；body 字段用 snake_case（reply_to 等）；错误体解析 { statusCode, name, message }；分页用 limit/after 且用最后一条的 id 做 cursor，循环直到 has_more 为 false。
expectations: Every request sets a `User-Agent` header in addition to `Authorization: Bearer ...` (the docs state requests without User-Agent are rejected with 403)
Request body field names are snake_case (`reply_to`, `scheduled_at`) since this is the raw REST API, not camelCase
Error handling reads the `name` and `message` fields from the JSON error body (not e.g. `error.code` or `error.type`)
Pagination loops on `has_more` and passes the last item's `id` as the `after` query parameter (not `page`, `offset`, or `next_cursor`)
The base URL is `https://api.resend.com` with no `/v1` prefix

evals.prompt: 我们是多租户 SaaS，每个租户要用自己的域名发通知。写一个 TypeScript 模块：onboardTenantDomain(tenantId, domain) 通过 Resend API 创建域名并返回租户需要添加的 DNS 记录；checkTenantDomain(tenantId) 触发验证并返回是否已验证；provisionTenantKey(tenantId) 给该租户生成一个只能发信、只能用该域名的 API key 并返回给租户保存。
evals.expected_output: POST /domains 用 { name } 创建并从响应 records 数组返回 DNS 记录；POST /domains/{id}/verify 触发验证，并通过 GET /domains/{id} 读 status（verified / pending / failed 等枚举）而不是假设 verify 同步返回 verified；POST /api-keys 用 permission: 'sending_access' 加 domain_id；说明返回的 token 只在创建时给一次。
expectations: Domain creation calls `POST /domains` (or `resend.domains.create`) with `name` and returns the DNS records from the response's `records` array
Verification does not assume `POST /domains/{id}/verify` synchronously returns a verified result; it re-reads the domain (`GET /domains/{id}`) and checks the `status` field against documented values
API key creation uses `permission: 'sending_access'` together with `domain_id` to scope the key to the tenant's domain (not a made-up `scope`/`role` field)
The code or comments note that the API key token is only returned once at creation and must be stored by the caller
The API key is read from an environment variable; no literal key or key-shaped placeholder appears

evals.prompt: 用 TypeScript 写一段脚本：把 users 表里 marketing_opt_in = true 的用户同步到 Resend 的 contacts，然后给'活跃付费用户'这个分段发一封 newsletter，标题'Product updates — September'，正文用我们已有的 HTML 字符串，要带个性化称呼和退订链接。第一次同步后以后每周跑。
evals.expected_output: 识别 Resend 的营销对象模型：contacts 独立于 audiences/segments（按 skill 记录的当前模型）；用 contacts.create（或 import）同步，已存在的联系人走更新而不是重复创建；创建 segment 或复用已有；发 newsletter 走 broadcasts.create + broadcasts.send（两步），而不是 emails.batch；正文里用 Resend 的合并变量语法（如 {{{contact.first_name|there}}}）和 {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}} 退订占位符，而不是自己拼退订链接。
expectations: The newsletter is sent through the Broadcasts API (create a broadcast, then send it), not by iterating contacts and calling `emails.send` / `batch.send`

Personalization and unsubscribe use Resend's broadcast merge-tag syntax as documented (triple braces with `contact.` prefix, e.g. `{{{contact.first_name|there}}}`, and `{{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}}`) rather than hand-built links, `{{first_name}}` Handlebars style, or an uppercase `{{{FIRST_NAME}}}` form that is not in the docs
Contact sync handles already-existing contacts (update / upsert or dedupe by email) instead of blindly creating duplicates every week
The segment/audience identifier passed to the broadcast matches the field name the skill documents for the current object model (segment_id vs audience_id), not an invented one
The API key is read from an environment variable; no literal key appears
